sourceTitle: CASHEW BUTTER STRAWBERRY CHRISTMAS TREE TREAT
sourceText:
CASHEW BUTTER STRAWBERRY CHRISTMAS TREE TREAT
By: Don Crouse
Published: Wednesday, December 20, 2017 - 10:32pm

Ingredients




1 pt strawberries
1 package chocolate mini muffins
1/4 c Betsy’s Best Gourmet Cashew Butter with Cardamom
1/4 c coconut shreds
1 c icing
2 T matcha powder
Red and Green sprinkles for decorating
Powdered sugar for garnish

Preparation

1 Wash and dry the strawberries and cut off the tops with the green leaves.  Cut the bottom of the chocolate mini muffin so you can top it with a dollop of Betsy’s Best and then place the strawberry on top.  Meanwhile add the matcha powder to the icing and stir until a uniform green color.  Place in a pastry bag with a star tip.  Decorate the outside of the strawberry with the icing and add the sprinkles to look like ordainments. Lightly dust powdered sugar on top to look like snow.Wash and dry the strawberries and cut off the tops with the green leaves. About

Oh Christmas Tree! Oh Christmas Tree! How Could You Be So Tasty!!!  With fun and super yummy ingredients, these Christmas Tree Treats will be a huge hit this Holiday season.  Made with strawberries, mini-chocolate muffins and Betsy's Best Gourmet Cashew Butter with Cardamom, you'll have to take pictures of your creation quickly because they won't last for long.
